# Column Harbor

> Column Harbor provides practical guides, tools, and tutorials for Excel, Google Sheets, Power Query, and CSV data troubleshooting.

## Main Sections

- [Home](https://jhsoftlabs.com/): Main dashboard and quick CSV diagnostic tools.
- [Excel Academy](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel): Step-by-step Excel curriculum from basics to advanced workflows.
- [Workspace](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace): Browser-local formula tools, workflows, and practice data packs.

- [Tool catalog, JSON](https://jhsoftlabs.com/tools.json): The same public task descriptions, examples and limits in a reusable format. No upload endpoint.

## Guides & Reference Articles

- [CSV Opens in One Column in Excel? Fix Comma or Semicolon Imports](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-opens-in-one-column): Fix a CSV file opening in one Excel column with From Text/CSV or Text to Columns. Use a semicolon sample to check quotes, empty fields, and leading zeros.
- [CSV Rows Have Different Column Counts: Find and Fix the Cause](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-different-column-counts): Diagnose CSV records with too many or too few fields, distinguish empty values from missing fields, and repair a small example without guessing.
- [CSV Row Count Is Wrong: Count Records with Quoted Newlines](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-row-count-newlines): Understand why CSV line counts differ from spreadsheet rows, count records with a CSV parser, and check quoted newlines without deleting valid data.
- [Commas and Double Quotes in CSV: Escape Fields Correctly](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-commas-double-quotes): Write CSV fields containing commas, quotation marks, and line breaks correctly, then verify a complete example with a parser and round-trip check.
- [Keep Leading Zeros in Excel CSV Imports and Exports](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-leading-zeros): Stop Excel removing leading zeros from CSV imports. Keep IDs as text, check zeros after saving, and choose the right setting for Excel 365 or 2024.
- [Excel Changes the Last Digit to Zero: Keep Long IDs Intact](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-long-numbers): Fix long IDs in Excel: distinguish scientific notation from 15-digit precision loss, import CSV IDs as Text, and test exact digits with sample files.
- [Excel SUM Returns Zero or Misses Values: Convert Numbers Stored as Text](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-sum-numbers-as-text): Diagnose amounts stored as text in Excel, convert them in a helper column with explicit separators, and verify both numeric count and total.
- [Import Decimal Commas in Excel Without Changing the Amounts](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-decimal-comma): Convert decimal-comma amounts in Excel using explicit source separators or Power Query locale, while keeping CSV delimiters and numeric values separate.
- [CSV Dates Have Day and Month Swapped: Import with the Right Locale](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-dates-day-month): Stop CSV dates being read in the wrong day and month order. Set the source locale, verify ambiguous dates, and keep original values for comparison.
- [Excel Dates Not Sorting Correctly? Fix Text Dates](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-dates-sort-as-text): Excel only sorts dates A to Z? Convert text dates with a checked formula or Text to Columns, then sort oldest to newest while keeping every row together.
- [Excel Changes Codes into Dates: Preserve the Column as Text](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-codes-turn-into-dates): Keep codes such as 3-4 and 12/2 from becoming Excel dates. Import identifiers as text, check the original values, and avoid unreliable format-only fixes.
- [Excel Date Serial Numbers and Time Fractions Explained](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-date-serial-numbers): Convert Excel date serial numbers into dates and times. Understand 0.5, 0.75 and fractions of a day, inspect hidden times, and check the 1900 or 1904 system.
- [CSV Accents Look Broken in Excel: Import the File as UTF-8](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-utf8-accents): Fix garbled CSV accents by selecting the correct encoding during import. Check UTF-8 previews, understand the BOM, and preserve the original source file.
- [Excel TRIM Not Working? Find and Remove Hidden Spaces](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/spreadsheet-trim-spaces): Fix Excel TRIM not removing spaces. Identify nonbreaking spaces, tabs and zero-width characters, choose a safe formula, and compare checked results.
- [Remove Duplicates in Google Sheets Without Losing Distinct Records](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/google-sheets-remove-duplicates): Remove duplicate rows in Google Sheets using a clear column rule. Compare Remove duplicates with UNIQUE, preserve originals, and review conflicting IDs.
- [Google Sheets SPLIT Drops Empty Fields: Preserve Their Column Positions](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/google-sheets-split-empty-fields): Keep empty fields in Google Sheets SPLIT with remove_empty_text set to FALSE. Set multi-character delimiter behavior and avoid using SPLIT as a CSV parser.
- [Power Query Append vs Merge: Stack Rows or Match Columns?](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/append-vs-merge): Choose append or merge for spreadsheet exports with a small order example, expected row counts, duplicate-key checks and practical Power Query steps.
- [Combine CSV Files in Excel with Power Query: A Folder Workflow](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/combine-csv-files-excel): Combine monthly CSV exports through Power Query with a source-file column, schema checks and an exact row-count example you can reconcile after refresh.
- [Compare Two CSV Files in Python: Find Added and Missing IDs](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/compare-csv-added-missing-ids): Compare old and new CSV snapshots by a unique text ID with a local Python script, exact sample results and checks for duplicate keys and mismatched rows.
- [VLOOKUP returns #N/A for IDs that look identical: what to check](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/vlookup-identical-ids-na): Diagnose VLOOKUP #N/A with exact-match settings, text-versus-number checks, hidden-space tests and a small SKU example that preserves meaningful zeros.
- [CSV vs XLSX: what you lose when saving a spreadsheet as CSV](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-vs-xlsx): Choose CSV or XLSX by what the recipient needs. See a small formula example, a practical export checklist and the workbook features a text table cannot keep.
- [Nested JSON to CSV in Python: One Row per Array Item](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/nested-json-to-csv): Convert a small nested order JSON file to CSV locally, preserving string IDs and empty orders while making array expansion and expected row counts explicit.
- [CSV to JSON in Python: Preserve Leading Zeros and Empty Fields](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/csv-to-json-preserve-types): Convert CSV to JSON in Python without pandas. Keep IDs as strings, preserve empty fields, or map blank quantities to null with an explicit schema.
- [Convert TSV to CSV in Python Without Changing Field Values](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/tsv-to-csv): Use a local Python script to convert quoted tab-separated data to CSV while preserving commas, quotes, blank fields and embedded line breaks in the sample.
- [Remove Duplicates in Excel and Keep the Latest Record](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-remove-duplicates-keep-latest): Keep the newest Excel record per ID by sorting before Remove Duplicates. Handle equal dates, blank IDs, invalid dates, and verify the retained rows.
- [VLOOKUP Between Two Sheets in Excel: Exact Matches and Missing IDs](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-vlookup-between-sheets): Pull a value from another Excel sheet with VLOOKUP. Lock the source range, check duplicate IDs, and distinguish a missing match from a blank or zero.
- [XLOOKUP with Multiple Criteria in Excel: Match Two Columns](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-xlookup-multiple-criteria): Match two Excel columns with XLOOKUP, count duplicate matches, and handle empty criteria or return cells. Includes a FILTER option for all matches.
- [Google Sheets QUERY GROUP BY: Sum by One or More Columns](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/google-sheets-query-group-by): Group Google Sheets rows with QUERY and SUM. Set input headers explicitly, group by two columns, exclude blank keys, and check mixed-type amounts.
- [Compare Two Lists in Excel: Find Missing IDs and Duplicate Counts](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-compare-two-lists): Compare two lists in Excel for missing values and matches. Highlight differences, extract results, compare sheets and audit duplicate counts with sample CSVs.
- [Sum Only Visible Rows in Excel: SUBTOTAL 9 vs 109 Explained](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-sum-visible-rows-subtotal): Sum filtered Excel rows with SUBTOTAL. Compare 9 and 109 in separate filter-only and manual-hide exercises, with sample data and checked expected totals.
- [Excel SUMIFS Date Range: Include the Whole End Date, Even with Times](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-sumifs-date-range): Sum Excel amounts between dates without missing late entries on the end date. Use a next-day boundary, real date-time values, category criteria, and checked examples.
- [Count Working Days Between Dates in Excel: NETWORKDAYS Includes Eligible Endpoints](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-networkdays-working-days): Count Excel business days with NETWORKDAYS and NETWORKDAYS.INTL. Verify inclusive endpoints, custom weekends, closures, same-day cases, and an exclusive-start rule.
- [Highlight Duplicate Rows in Excel When Both Columns Must Match](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-conditional-formatting-duplicate-rows): Highlight repeated two-column Excel records with an exact conditional-formatting range. Compare whole pairs, exclude incomplete rows, and choose all or later occurrences.
- [Google Sheets FILTER No Matches: Diagnose the Criteria Before Hiding the Error](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/google-sheets-filter-no-matches): Fix no matches in Google Sheets FILTER with aligned ranges, separate condition checks, and a safe no-results message. Download a complete worked example.
- [Power Query Merge Creates Duplicate Rows? Fix Extra Rows](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/power-query-merge-duplicates-extra-rows): Fix extra rows after a Power Query merge. Count matches before expanding, diagnose duplicate keys, and run downloadable M queries with a checked example.
- [Excel PivotTable Shows Count Instead of Sum: Fix the Source and the Value Field](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-pivot-table-count-instead-of-sum): Change a PivotTable from Count to Sum, convert amount text safely, retain real blanks and zeros, and verify totals against a small source table.
- [Excel FILTER #SPILL! Error: Find the Blocker Without Deleting Your Data](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-filter-spill-error): Fix Excel FILTER spill errors with an exact three-row example. Check occupied cells, tables, merged cells, output size, and a separate no-match result.
- [Count Checked Boxes in Google Sheets: Tasks, Categories and Completion Rate](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/google-sheets-countif-checkboxes): Count checked and unchecked Google Sheets boxes without including empty template rows. Handle custom values and calculate a task-based completion rate.

- [PivotTable Missing New Rows After Refresh? Check Its Source Range](https://jhsoftlabs.com/guides/excel-pivot-table-missing-new-rows): Include new rows in an Excel PivotTable by checking its source range, switching to an Excel Table, refreshing, and checking filters against sample totals.

## Excel Academy Lessons

- [Find your way around a workbook, cells, and ranges](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/workbook-cells-ranges): foundations — Build a small inventory sheet and learn to identify exactly which cells an action will affect.
- [Enter and correct data without changing its meaning](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/enter-edit-data): foundations — Practice safe text and number entry, correction, cancellation, and undo on a three-row inventory.
- [Format numbers without confusing display and value](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/number-formats): foundations — Make decimals, percentages, prices, and fixed-width codes readable while preserving their underlying meaning.
- [Sort complete records and filter a focused view](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/sort-filter): foundations — Reorder a small order list safely, then display only the records meeting two conditions.
- [Build your first formulas from cell references](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/first-formulas): formulas — Calculate order totals, inspect the expression behind the result, and test how parentheses change arithmetic.
- [Copy formulas while keeping shared inputs fixed](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/relative-absolute-references): formulas — Use relative, absolute, and mixed references to apply one discount rule across several rows and columns.
- [Choose the right total, average, and count](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/sum-average-count): formulas — Discover how blanks, zero, and text affect numeric summaries.
- [Turn clear rules into IF, AND, and OR formulas](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/if-and-or): formulas — Label orders with explicit conditions, including boundaries and missing inputs.
- [Turn an order range into a growing Excel table](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/excel-tables): organize — Build a named table, calculate each order line, and verify that a new record enters the total.
- [Guide data entry with dropdowns and number limits](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/data-validation): organize — Create a status list and a whole-number rule, then distinguish entry guidance from a complete data audit.
- [Clean hidden spaces without losing the original text](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/clean-text): organize — Inspect ordinary and nonbreaking spaces, apply a named cleanup rule, and compare the output with its source.
- [Build dates and calculate elapsed hours safely](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/dates-times): organize — Construct numeric date-times from explicit components and separate stored values from their display formats.
- [Answer the same business question with a sum and a count](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/sumifs-countifs): lookup — Use multiple criteria to total paid orders and verify how many records contributed to the answer.
- [Look up a product with an explicit exact match](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/xlookup-exact-match): lookup — Retrieve a name and price by product ID, handle a missing ID, and recognize the limits of a first-match result.
- [Build an exact lookup with INDEX and MATCH](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/index-match): lookup — Find a key's position, return its corresponding value, and keep the method compatible with Excel 2016 and 2019.
- [Create a filtered report that spills into empty cells](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/dynamic-arrays): lookup — Use FILTER, UNIQUE, and SORT to create a changing result area while preserving repeated source records.
- [Build a PivotTable and prove that its totals are right](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/pivot-tables): analysis — Summarize six orders by month and region, distinguish money totals from record counts, and refresh after a controlled change.
- [Create a chart that answers one clear question](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/charts-that-explain): analysis — Chart monthly order counts, add a meaningful target, and keep totals and missing observations from distorting the picture.
- [Highlight rows with a rule you can explain](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/conditional-formatting): analysis — Flag low stock with a mixed-reference formula while distinguishing missing quantities from genuine zero stock.
- [Use Goal Seek, then check whether the answer makes sense](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/what-if-analysis): analysis — Work backward from a target profit to a required quantity, and handle fractional answers without pretending the model guarantees real sales.
- [Import CSV without damaging identifiers](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/import-csv-safely): repeatable — Choose encoding, delimiter and types before loading, then verify leading zeros, long IDs, quoted names and numeric amounts.
- [Turn one CSV import into a repeatable query](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/power-query-first-import): repeatable — Record an explicit type, trimming, filtering and calculation sequence, then prove that refreshing reruns that sequence.
- [Append orders, merge customer names, and check the row count](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/power-query-merge-append): repeatable — Use three small source tables to distinguish stacking records from matching keys, including a missing customer and a duplicate-key trap.
- [Build a monthly report with a repeatable import and a reconciliation](https://jhsoftlabs.com/learn/excel/monthly-report-capstone): repeatable — Take eight clean orders through import, month-and-region totals, validation, a chart and a controlled refresh.

## Workspace Workflows & Tools

- [Compare Two CSV Files by Key: Added, Removed and Changed Rows](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/compare-csv-files): Check a new CSV export against the previous one by ID. Find added, removed and changed records, review unresolved keys and download the before/after report locally.
- [CSV to Excel Without Losing Leading Zeros or Long IDs](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/csv-to-excel): Create an XLSX workbook from CSV with explicitly typed text cells. Preserve leading zeros, long identifiers, Unicode and literal formula-like values locally.
- [Save and Repeat a CSV Cleanup Workflow in Your Browser](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/repeat-cleanup): Run whitespace cleanup, explicit key-based deduplication and column selection together. Save only numeric settings locally and review the mapping for each new CSV.
- [Shopify Product CSV Checker: Review Import Issues Locally](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/shopify-csv-checker): Check supported Shopify product CSV headers, values and row relationships locally. Download findings and distinguish file issues from checks that need the actual store.
- [Compare Two Lists: Find Matches and Missing Values](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/compare-two-lists): Paste two lists to find shared and missing values. Choose case and edge-space rules, inspect collapsed repeats and download a filtered comparison locally.
- [Clean CSV Whitespace: Trim Spaces, Tabs and Nonbreaking Spaces](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/clean-csv): Clean spaces and tabs in selected CSV columns. Replace nonbreaking spaces, choose whether internal gaps collapse, preview changed cells and download locally.
- [Remove CSV Duplicates by Selected Columns and Keep the First Row](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/remove-csv-duplicates): Choose duplicate key columns, keep the first matching CSV record and download removed rows separately. Review optional case and space matching locally.
- [Convert CSV or TSV to JSON, Comma, Semicolon, Tab or Pipe](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/convert-csv): Convert headered CSV or TSV to string-valued JSON or delimited text. Preserve leading zeros, empty fields and quoted line breaks in a local browser tool.
- [Extract and Reorder CSV Columns Without Changing Row Order](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/extract-csv-columns): Select the CSV fields you need and arrange their output order. Preview a smaller table, preserve source row order and download the result locally.
- [Split a CSV by Data Records and Repeat the Header in Every File](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/split-csv): Split a small CSV into record-based files with repeated headers. Keep quoted multiline fields together, choose rows per part and download each result locally.
- [Make imported customer labels consistent](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-clean-imported-labels): Replace nonbreaking spaces and tidy a selected label column before matching or grouping records.
- [Trim label edges without flattening internal spacing](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-clean-edges-only): Remove unwanted boundary spaces while keeping meaningful gaps between words.
- [Remove repeated member records without merging different cities](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-dedupe-complete-member-records): Compare all relevant fields so a repeated member ID does not erase a distinct record.
- [Keep the latest customer revision after sorting](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-dedupe-latest-reviewed-record): Use an explicit date and revision order before keeping the first row for each customer.
- [Find product IDs added or missing between exports](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-compare-product-snapshots): Compare identifier membership across two snapshots without relying on row order.
- [Compare two lists with an explicit case and space rule](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-compare-case-and-spaces): Separate missing IDs from differences caused by letter case, leading spaces, or repeated occurrences.
- [Convert CSV to JSON without changing IDs or blanks](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-convert-csv-json-strings): Create an array of objects while keeping the CSV field values as strings.
- [Convert a quoted TSV export to CSV](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-convert-quoted-tsv): Change the field separator while preserving commas, literal tabs, quotes, and multiline notes.
- [Prepare a small order lookup file with columns in the right order](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-extract-order-lookup-columns): Extract just the fields needed by the next step without changing their values or matching another table.
- [Split a CSV into smaller files without breaking multiline notes](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-split-multiline-csv-records): Split by complete data records instead of physical lines in the text file.
- [Check a supplier export that opens in one Excel column](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-inspect-semicolon-export): Identify the intended separator before attempting cleanup or conversion.
- [Check long product IDs before importing them into Excel](https://jhsoftlabs.com/workspace/workflows#recipe-inspect-long-identifiers): Keep a text reference so a display change cannot hide lost identifier digits.
